entries.title: Hosea 11:1
segments: ¶"When Israel [was] a child, I loved him, And out of Egypt I called My son.

entries.title: Hosea 11:2
segments: [As] they called them, So they went from them; They sacrificed to the Baals, And burned incense to carved images.

entries.title: Hosea 11:3
segments: "I taught Ephraim to walk, Taking them by their arms; But they did not know that I healed them.

entries.title: Hosea 11:4
segments: I drew them with gentle cords, With bands of love, And I was to them as those who take the yoke from their neck. I stooped [and] fed them.

entries.title: Hosea 11:5
segments: "He shall not return to the land of Egypt; But the Assyrian shall be his king, Because they refused to repent.

entries.title: Hosea 11:6
segments: And the sword shall slash in his cities, Devour his districts, And consume [them], Because of their own counsels.

entries.title: Hosea 11:7
segments: My people are bent on backsliding from Me. Though they call to the Most High, None at all exalt [Him].

entries.title: Hosea 11:8
segments: ¶"How can I give you up, Ephraim? [How] can I hand you over, Israel? How can I make you like Admah? [How] can I set you like Zeboiim? My heart churns within Me; My sympathy is stirred.

entries.title: Hosea 11:9
segments: I will not execute the fierceness of My anger; I will not again destroy Ephraim. For I [am] God, and not man, The Holy One in your midst; And I will not come with terror.

entries.title: Hosea 11:10
segments: "They shall walk after the LORD. He will roar like a lion. When He roars, Then [His] sons shall come trembling from the west;

entries.title: Hosea 11:11
segments: They shall come trembling like a bird from Egypt, Like a dove from the land of Assyria. And I will let them dwell in their houses," Says the LORD.

entries.title: Hosea 11:12
segments: "Ephraim has encircled Me with lies, And the house of Israel with deceit; But Judah still walks with God, Even with the Holy One [who is] faithful.
